title: Uruguayan Beetroot Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful stir fry recipe from Uruguay, featuring roasted beetroot, perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Wrap the beetroot in foil and roast for 45 minutes, or until tender.
While the beetroot is roasting, heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the garlic and onion to the pan and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until softened.
Once the beetroot is done, remove it from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Peel the beetroot and slice it into thin strips.
Add the sliced beetroot to the pan with the garlic and onion, and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
